visual_argument: Texas held up as a slab of its own ground under a gold sheet of what the satellite read: the act of reading all 254 counties from orbit, one costly ground monitor on an empty flat, the satellite's eight gold wedges onto the state, a carved column of eight air bands with sulfur dioxide proud, four survey pads with the fit staked on the winner, three grounds under rising gold haze west to east, a floor of 254 flags with slate clumps, one resident inside a block of averaged air, and satellite blocks everywhere but a sharp circle round a monitor with one gold block to check first.
build_risk: Frame 5 must stage a contest of four methods while drawing a fit value only for the winner: 79 of 100 flagged stakes must read at feed size and the three losing pads must read as contestants without implying any fit value for them.
